coaching/index.html.body: Skip to content ☰ Home Coached by Tom Female Performance Plan Only Plan Store About Us Blog Contact Coached by Tom · £185 a month · Limited places A coach in your corner for all of it The full thing. One to one, completely bespoke, and a professional coach in your corner the whole way. I build your programme around your race, your life and your body, then I'm with you every step: feedback every week, proper analysis of the sessions that matter, and a hand with everything that decides the day, from pacing and fuelling to race craft, bike fit and the mental side. Ask about a Coached by Tom place See what you get Everything you get Complete world class coaching This is the highest level of support I offer, for the athlete who wants a coach who understands them and their training completely. In-depth analysis of every session, a holistic approach across bike fit, race craft, fuelling and the mental side, and a plan that's truly yours, built and read by me. A completely bespoke programme Your whole training programme, built for you from the ground up and delivered through TrainingPeaks. In-depth training and progress analysis Your training and progress analysed in depth with TrainingPeaks and WKO5, so decisions come from your data, not a hunch. Free TrainingPeaks Premium A free TrainingPeaks Premium account for as long as we work together, so you see everything I see. Unlimited plan amendments Change it as often as you need. When life or your form shifts, the plan shifts with it, no limits. Weekly session feedback Feedback on your sessions every week, plus preparation tips for what is coming next. Unlimited contact Instant messaging day to day and regular video catch-ups. You are never left guessing between sessions. Science-backed methodology Evidence-led training including dedicated heat-preparation sessions when your race demands them. All the things that count on race day Race craft, race prep, kit and equipment, nutrition and psychology. The parts of performance a training file alone cannot cover. How a month looks The weekly rhythm Your block lands Three weeks of training built around your life, calibrated to where your form is right now and where it needs to be to reach your dream goal, delivered to your TrainingPeaks account. Every session earns its place Every session in your plan has a purpose. If I can't justify why it's there, it doesn't go in. Message me any time to move something or talk it through, and contact is unlimited, so you are never left guessing between sessions. Read, analysed, fed back on I read the sessions you complete, analyse them against what was set using your actual data in TrainingPeaks and WKO5, and feed back on them. Feedback is a key part of the coaching journey, so each week you get a full round of feedback on everything you have completed. We talk, the plan moves Block by block video catch-ups, WhatsApp for general chat, and the next block reflects real life and your numbers as they move. Trackside on the Ironman Wales bike course Race support A proper race plan, before every start line Before every event you get a race plan built for that day: pacing for the climbs and the flats, a fuelling strategy you have rehearsed, heat and weather contingencies, and the race craft that decides close finishes. These are the same detailed race-plan documents our athletes have taken to Ironman Wales, long-course triathlon and the Haute Route, not a paragraph of generic advice. I do not like surprises, other than birthdays and Christmas. A race should be the controlled execution of the training you have rehearsed, so you start the day knowing every element of it: your kit and equipment, your pacing strategy and your fuelling strategy, all practised and proven. That is what lets you actually enjoy the big day. We build the strategy together, so on the day you are not hoping it goes well. You know the plan, because it is yours. Ironman Wales bike course: elevation and wind race-plan snapshot IRONMAN WALES · THE BIKE COURSE Real IMWA course data. 178 km, 2,421 m of climbing, 58 climbs. 178 km Bike leg 2,421 m Total ascent 20% Steepest ELEVATION · SHADED WHERE POWER MATTERS MOST 0 20 40 60 80 100 120 140 160 3 88 174 Steepest pitch 20% Longest drag 85 m m Distance along the bike course (km) WIND ON THE COURSE · A SAMPLE FRESH WSW DAY Start / finish N E S W WIND FROM THE WSW blowing toward the ENE A sample fresh WSW wind (from 247.5°), typical of a Pembrokeshire race day. Every metre of the route is coloured by whether you push into it, ride with it, or handle it side-on. Headwind 43% Tailwind 43% Crosswind 15% The bike leg of IRONMAN Wales, one of the toughest courses my athletes race, straight from the real course file: roughly 178 km and 2,421 m of climbing. The profile shows where the power goes on the climbs and the sustained drags, and the wind panel shows how a fresh westerly turns the same road into a headwind one way and a tailwind the other. Your plan gets the same treatment for your event. Why places are limited I keep this group small on purpose. I only ever open 15 Coached by Tom spots, because this level of support, weekly feedback, unlimited contact and a coach reading every session, is not something I can give properly to more than a small cohort. When those 15 are taken, it is full. Ian C Cycling athlete I can't recommend Tom enough. Over the past year, the support, structure, and guidance I received helped me progress massively and achieve my Ironman goal, finishing in 11h13. jc b Ironman finisher, 11h13 Really enjoyed being coached by Horsepower Coaching. Tom really knows his stuff and is easy to talk to. If ever I had any questions, Tom was always quick to answer & provided detailed race plans for my various events. Would highly recommend. Emma N Multi-event athlete I've been working with Tom at Horsepower Coaching for the past year, it was the best decision I made for my cycling and I cannot recommend Tom highly enough to anyone seeking a cycling coach. His personalised approach, attention to detail, and unwavering support have been amazing. What sets Tom apart is his genuine passion for both coaching and wanting you to succeed. His training is a great balance between professional and friendly, and is always able to adapt to anything and everything. He always takes the time to provide personalised regular and understandable feedback, being there to answer any questions no matter how small. Lastly the level of support he provided on the day of the event was amazing. If you're looking for a coach who will go the extra mile and genuinely care about your progress, Tom is the one to choose. Having decided to train for another Ironman with ever increasing work and family commitments, it was important that my training sessions were efficient and high quality, and Tom has delivered this, and more. Tom is a wealth of knowledge, friendly, adaptable, patient with injuries, and a great mentor. Highly recommended. Guy L Ironman athlete I've recently started working with Tom and his attention to detail is second to none. I've been coached for 10 years and Tom is the first coach I've had that has really listened, paid attention to detail, identified issues and then tries to figure out a logical way to address them that works for me as an individual. Really looking forward to working through some mental barriers with Tom and see where that takes me on my triathlon journey. Brilliant coaching service and guidance with incredible knowledge and detail. Naomi S Triathlete Tom and I worked together for 2 seasons, covering sprint and middle distance triathlons and a road racing season. During that time, my running came on beyond my wildest expectations and I hit the start line on my first 70.3 fully prepared and in the best shape I've been in a while. I fully recommend Tom to anybody who would be interested in improving themselves as an athlete. Work and family took priority, and a broken collarbone and hip didn't help. Over the last 1.5 years, I made fitness a priority again, lost 12 kg, and got ready for the challenge. The dream was to finish a 70.3 before turning 50 with a personal best. Tom's professional guidance, training plans, personal coaching, and practical tips made all the difference and got me proudly across the finish line. The dream came true! cycling-coaching/index.html.body: Skip to content ☰ Home Coached by Tom Female Performance Plan Only Plan Store About Us Blog Contact Cycling coaching, South West UK and online Cycling Coaching Cycling coaching built for your event, from sportives and hill climbs to 100 mile TTs and ultra racing. Written by me and delivered through TrainingPeaks. Find your plan Explore Plan Only Cycling coaching from sportives to ultra-distance I coach cyclists from their first sportive or hill climb to the perfect 25 mile time trial, gran fondos, Everestings and full-blown ultra-distance racing. Coaching with Horsepower is built around the event you're chasing, the hours you've actually got and your own power numbers, located in the South West of the UK and coaching online across the UK and worldwide. Every plan is written by me and delivered straight into TrainingPeaks, the load built in three-week blocks and every target set as a percentage of your own numbers so it fits you and not some average. Climbing, time trialling, endurance and the race craft that wins the day. No nonsense, quality over quantity. What cycling coaching with me actually covers Bike racing rewards the rider who has trained the right thing, not simply the most. So we build the engine with structured endurance and threshold work, then sharpen it for the specific demands of your event, whether that is the repeatable climbing of a gran fondo, the single savage effort of a hill climb, or the pacing discipline of a long time trial. Position, fuelling and pacing get the same attention as the numbers, because on the day they decide as much as your FTP ever does. It suits the rider who knows there is more in there and wants a coach to find it: the sportive rider stepping up to a first big alpine day, the time triallist chasing a personal best, the ultra-distance rider learning to keep moving when it turns hard. It is all delivered online from the South West of the UK, so wherever you ride, the coaching comes with you. Three ways to train with Horsepower Your paths into cycling coaching Pick the level of support that fits: a proven plan you run yourself, a bespoke plan with feedback each block, or the full coaching relationship. female-performance/index.html.body: Skip to content ☰ Home Coached by Tom Female Performance Plan Only Plan Store About Us Blog Contact Female performance Female first, not female adapted. Most plans are built around male physiology and handed to women to get on with. I do it the other way round. Your plan starts from how a female athlete actually trains, adapts and recovers, and when I coach you it bends around your cycle and your life, not some average that was never you in the first place. Explore Plan Only See the plans Why "female adapted" fails Most training plans, most research and most coaching were built around the male athlete, then shrunk to fit everyone else. Women got trained as small men. That ignores what actually shapes how a female athlete responds to training: how you recover, how you fuel, the strength work that protects your bones and tendons, and how load is best spread across your week. Turning a men's plan down isn't the same as building the right one. What female first actually means Female first means the plan starts from the female athlete rather than a template. It means recovery-respecting structure so the work lands instead of grinding you down, and strength work built in for long-term bone and tendon health rather than bolted on as an afterthought. And it means I'm honest about what each level of support can and can't do. Plan Only and Coached by Tom Genuinely cycle-aware coaching This is where female-specific training stops being a label and gets personal. When I coach you, three things happen that a downloadable plan can't. The plan adapts around your physiology. Load, recovery and intensity are shaped to how you respond, not to an average athlete. Feedback reads your sessions in context. What your body actually did, alongside your reported symptoms, recovery and where you are in your cycle. Strength for bone and tendon is built in. Not bolted on, because long-term durability is part of performance, not separate from it. I'm honest about the limits: coaching is personalised week to week, and I'll never overclaim what it does. I coach with a particular emphasis on female-specific performance development, built from years of working with female athletes from first finish lines to the front of the race. Explore Plan Only Coach with Tom The women who prove it Real names, real results Female results, not female participation. Horsepower is proud to have supported some amazing women on their journey to Ironman wins, XTRI podiums and course records. Every name below is one of them. Tom really knows his stuff and is easy to talk to. If ever I had any questions, Tom was always quick to answer & provided detailed race plans for my various events. Would highly recommend. Emma N Multi-event athlete I've been working with Tom at Horsepower Coaching for the past year, it was the best decision I made for my cycling and I cannot recommend Tom highly enough to anyone seeking a cycling coach. His personalised approach, attention to detail, and unwavering support have been amazing. What sets Tom apart is his genuine passion for both coaching and wanting you to succeed. His training is a great balance between professional and friendly, and is always able to adapt to anything and everything. He always takes the time to provide personalised regular and understandable feedback, being there to answer any questions no matter how small. Lastly the level of support he provided on the day of the event was amazing. If you're looking for a coach who will go the extra mile and genuinely care about your progress, Tom is the one to choose. Rebecca W Cycling athlete I've recently started working with Tom and his attention to detail is second to none. I've been coached for 10 years and Tom is the first coach I've had that has really listened, paid attention to detail, identified issues and then tries to figure out a logical way to address them that works for me as an individual. Really looking forward to working through some mental barriers with Tom and see where that takes me on my triathlon journey. Brilliant coaching service and guidance with incredible knowledge and detail. Naomi S Triathlete › Read all 15 reviews on Google Female performance, answered What is female-specific endurance training? It is training designed for a female athlete from the ground up, not a men's plan with the numbers scaled down. It respects the physiological differences that shape recovery, fuelling, strength needs and how training load is best spread across the week. Do Horsepower's off-the-shelf plans sync to my menstrual cycle? No, and I won't claim they do. A downloadable plan cannot know where you are in your cycle, so instead my Female-First plans use recovery-respecting structure and dedicated strength work for bone and tendon health that benefit every female athlete. Genuine cycle-aware training comes with coaching, where the plan adapts around you. What makes Horsepower's coaching cycle-aware? When I coach you, I read the sessions you actually complete in the context of what your body was doing, and I adapt the next block around your physiology, your symptoms and your feedback. It's personalised to you, not a generic template. Which female-specific training plans does Horsepower offer? Four Female-First plans are live now: 70.3, Olympic-distance triathlon, marathon and century. Each is built for a female athlete targeting that specific event. Is female-specific training only for elite athletes? No. The same approach that supports my racing athletes supports a first-timer. It's about training the athlete in front of me properly, at every level and life stage. The entry point Female-First training plans Start here. Four plans, each built for a female athlete targeting its event, with recovery-respecting structure and dedicated strength work for bone and tendon health. What they do not do is claim to sync to your menstrual cycle: an off-the-shelf plan cannot know where you are in yours, so I won't pretend it does. That's what coaching is for. triathlon-coaching/index.html.body: Skip to content ☰ Home Coached by Tom Female Performance Plan Only Plan Store About Us Blog Contact Triathlon coaching, South West UK and online Triathlon Coaching Triathlon coaching built for your race, from your first sprint to Ironman. Written by me, delivered through TrainingPeaks, from the South West of the UK and coaching worldwide. Find your plan Explore Plan Only Triathlon coaching for every distance I'm Tom Cooling, and I coach triathletes from a first sprint all the way to Ironman, long course and the extreme XTRI races like Norseman. Whether you're chasing your first 70.3 finish or a podium at Ironman Wales, coaching with Horsepower puts you and your dream at the centre of it, built around your target race, your life and your numbers, located in the South West of the UK and coaching online worldwide. Every plan is written by me and delivered straight into TrainingPeaks, built in three-week blocks so the load lands and the hard sessions are dosed the way the research says fitness is actually built. Swim, bike, run and the transitions in between, all prepared properly. Quality over quantity, every time. What triathlon coaching with me actually covers Triathlon is really four sports, not three, because the transitions and the way the three disciplines feed into each other decide as much as any single one. So we work the whole picture: a swim that leaves you fresh for the bike, bike pacing that protects your run, and a run built on the durability to hold form when you are tired. Around that sits the strength work, the fuelling you rehearse until it is boring, and the heat and race-craft preparation the bigger days demand. It suits the athlete who wants a coach reading their actual sessions, not a template downloaded and forgotten. First-timers who want to reach the start line genuinely ready, age-groupers chasing a championship slot, and plenty of people in between. Wherever you are in the UK or further afield, the coaching is delivered online from the South West, so the only thing that changes is your postcode, never the standard. Three ways to train with Horsepower Your paths into triathlon coaching Pick the level of support that fits: a proven plan you run yourself, a bespoke plan with feedback each block, or the full coaching relationship.
